# learning-platform-core 0.1.0

These browser assets are vendored from `learning-platform-core` commit
`f484b2d` (`feat: initialise shared learning platform core`). They are kept in a
versioned directory so this static GitHub Pages hub has no runtime dependency on
GitHub or npm and can be rolled back with its own reviewed commit.

The JavaScript and CSS files are unmodified build outputs. `LICENSE` is copied
from the same commit.
